caption: The drawing shows a single main object, a bonnet, rendered in color on a plain, off-white background. The bonnet’s exterior is predominantly purple, with a smooth, rounded shape and a scalloped edge along the bottom. The bonnet is decorated with three round buttons and thin, yellowish lines that form a triangular pattern and outline some edges. The interior lining is visible along the front opening and features a cream or light beige color with a diagonal crisscross pattern in a darker shade. Two long, ribbon-like tassels with alternating pink and green lines hang down from the back edge of the bonnet. To the right of the main colored image is a smaller, lightly sketched outline of the same bonnet, seen from the back, with emphasis on button placement and the tassels. The paper has areas of slight orange and pink stains near the edges and random spots of coloration.
title: Bonnet
